title: The Consistent rule for the class
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：consistent　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 consistent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the craftsman wrote of ① a consistent rule for the class in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② more consistent than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the consistent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most consistent rule for the class anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1974 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too consistent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the consistent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a consistent habit of rising early, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as consistent as the habit of rising early they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was consistent or not, and he said so.

By 1987 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something consistent, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite consistent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the consistent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1990, for the whole place, she wrote of another consistent rule for the class in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more consistent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most consistent habit of rising early in the whole workshop, she said in 1992, was the one she could never quite name; the consistent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 一致（前置定语 a consistent rule for the class：1980 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件一致的规矩）
B. adj. 一致／始终如一（比较级 more consistent than：文中两处，一处比班上的规矩，一处比预想）
C. adj. 一致／始终如一（最高级 the most consistent：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 一致（表语 too consistent to do：母亲觉得它太一致，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 始终如一（前置定语 a consistent habit of rising early：叔叔把整件事称作一桩始终如一的习惯）
F. adj. 始终如一（同级比较 as consistent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩早起的习惯相比）
G. adj. 始终如一（后置定语 something consistent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 始终如一（受程度副词修饰 quite consistent：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a consistent rule for the class
the most consistent rule for the class anybody
a consistent habit of rising early
The most consistent habit of rising early in

answers.why: consistent 意为“一致”，1980 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件一致的规矩”，此处作前置定语 a consistent rule for the class。
consistent 意为“一致”，此处用比较级 more consistent than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
consistent 意为“一致”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说它是工坊里最一致的一件，故用最高级 the most consistent rule for the class。
consistent 意为“一致”，母亲认为这件东西“太一致了，谁也用不上”，too consistent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
consistent 意为“始终如一”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩始终如一的习惯”，此处作前置定语 a consistent habit of rising early。
consistent 意为“始终如一”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩早起的习惯一样始终如一”，同级比较用 as consistent as。
consistent 意为“始终如一”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“始终如一的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something consistent。
consistent 意为“始终如一”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当始终如一”，quite 修饰原级 consistent。
consistent 意为“始终如一”，1990 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要始终如一”，故用比较级 more consistent than。
consistent 意为“始终如一”，母亲 1992 年说的是“整个工坊里最始终如一的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most consistent habit of rising early。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件一致的规矩。（a consistent rule for the class）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更一致。（more consistent than …）
母亲觉得它太一致，谁也用不上。（too consistent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩始终如一的习惯。（a consistent habit of rising early）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩早起的习惯一样始终如一。（as consistent as …）
到了 1987 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件始终如一的东西。（something consistent）
answers: In 1980 the craftsman wrote of a consistent rule for the class in the ledger.
Everybody said it was more consistent than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too consistent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a consistent habit of rising early.
He said nobody would call it as consistent as the habit of rising early they had once had.
By 1987 the ledger asked for nothing but something consistent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 consistent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the craftsman wrote of a consistent rule for the class in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most consistent rule for the class in the workshop, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too consistent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a consistent habit of rising early, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite consistent, and everybody laughed.
The consistent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
